definitions.explanation: The surface or shape exposed when an object is cut through, or a diagram showing such a view. Used in technical, scientific, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断面|だんめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: The cross-section of the cake is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {断面|だんめん}{図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look at the cross-sectional diagram.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断面|だんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年輪|ねんりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The tree rings are clearly visible in this tree's cross-section.

notes:
Compound of {断|だん} (cut) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface). Refers to the surface revealed when something is sliced through. Used both technically (engineering, science) and colloquially (food photography, where showing a beautiful cross-section is popular on social media — often called ⟦{萌|も}え→萌える：02434_moeru⟧{断|だん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断面|だんめん}{図|ず}: cross-sectional diagram
- {断面|だんめん}{積|せき}: cross-sectional area
- {断面|だんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show the cross-section
- ⟦{萌|も}え→萌える：02434_moeru⟧{断|だん}: visually appealing cross-section (of food, slang)

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧: side view, lateral surface
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: surface (outer)
